name: Bouncemasters 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Bouncemasters is an arcade cute game where a polar bear smacks a penguin with a bat and your job is to keep that penguin soaring for as long as possible. Time your hits, bounce off animals below, collect coins in midair, and chase new distance records as you work your way across the board.
